verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe broadcasts (compose, define recipients, schedule/send at a specified time) via UI or API, plus segment-based audience targeting, Design Studio for drafting emails, and transactional/automation sends — covering the full compose-audience-send/schedule loop.
